mapper.select: /* Attd04Mapper.selectAttdStdTimeRuleList */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.STD_TIME_RULE_TYPE AS stdTimeRuleType , A.STD_TIME_TYPE AS stdTimeType FROM TB_ATTD_STD_TIME_RULE A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd}

/* Attd04Mapper.selectAttdStdTimeRuleHistList */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , B.HIST_IDX AS histIdx , A.STD_TIME_RULE_TYPE AS stdTimeRuleType , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH( A.CMPNY_CD , 'SYST_VAL' , A.STD_TIME_RULE_TYPE , 'SYS028' ) AS stdTimeRuleTypeNm , B.STD_TIME_TYPE AS stdTimeType , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH( A.CMPNY_CD , 'SYST_VAL' , B.STD_TIME_TYPE , 'SYS029' ) AS stdTimeTypeNm , B.INSERT_NO AS insertNo , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH( A.CMPNY_CD , 'USER_NM' , B.INSERT_NO , null ) AS insertNm , B.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate FROM TB_ATTD_STD_TIME_RULE A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ATTD_STD_TIME_RULE_HIS B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.STD_TIME_RULE_TYPE = B.STD_TIME_RULE_TYPE ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} ORDER BY B.HIST_IDX DESC
